question: What division of eight octads is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division of eight octads is named
Full knowledge of it is desired
The knowing is described as endless
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division of the eight octads in its endless extent.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the division or the manner of knowing
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
